name: Jennifer & Max
text: When Max swallowed something he shouldn't have, {{COMPANY_NAME}} got us in immediately and rushed him into emergency surgery. The team called me with updates the whole night and treated him like their own. Max made a full recovery and we couldn't be more grateful.

name: Robert & Bella
text: Bella is nervous at the vet, but the team at {{COMPANY_NAME}} is so patient and gentle with her. Her wellness exams are thorough and they always take time to explain everything. It's clear they genuinely love animals.

name: Maria & Cooper
text: Cooper's teeth were in rough shape and I was worried about the anesthesia. {{COMPANY_NAME}} walked me through the whole dental procedure, did pre-surgical bloodwork, and monitored him closely. His breath is fresh and he's eating like a puppy again!

name: David & Luna
text: Luna was diagnosed with a thyroid condition and the internal medicine team has been amazing. They ran the diagnostics in-house, explained the treatment plan clearly, and check in regularly. She's back to her playful self.

name: The Thompson Family
text: We've trusted {{COMPANY_NAME}} with all three of our pets for years. From puppy vaccines to senior care, they're always there when we need them — even late at night. We wouldn't go anywhere else.
